applicant_utility.summary: This is NTU's flagship undergraduate award and it is genuinely open to all nationalities, including non-Asians, with full subsidised tuition after the MOE Tuition Grant, S$6,500 a year for living, up to S$2,000 for hostel accommodation, up to S$8,000 for an approved overseas attachment, a one-off S$2,000 computer allowance and enrolment in the NTU Honours College. There is no bond and no post-graduation obligation of NTU's own, but the Tuition Grant you must take carries a three-year work obligation in a Singapore-based alliance entity for international students. The one trap is timing: the scholarship application window closes before the admission window reopens later the same day, so if you apply for admission first you have permanently ruled yourself out of this scholarship for that cycle.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong academic and co-curricular applicants of any nationality applying for a full-time NTU undergraduate degree who can submit inside the scholarship window for their qualification

Plan to keep a CGPA of at least 3.50 out of 5.00 across renewals, and document your CCA record and referees in advance
Upload your photograph and complete the appraisal form by the published date, not just the application date

Assuming the travel grant covers any exchange: it is tied to an approved Overseas Student Programme attachment and, from AY2025, to at most two of them

applicant_utility.summary: NPGS is unusual in that you do not apply for it at all: you apply for a PhD at NTU through the Graduate Admission System and the College of Graduate Studies and the relevant School select from that pool. The package is S$4,300 a month for international students, full annual tuition, a S$1,250 annual book grant, S$600 for IT, S$600 for your thesis and up to S$5,000 a year for overseas conferences, with only the accommodation priority restricted to international students. Crucially, if you are applying directly for a PhD programme, for SINGA, or for the SMART Visiting Student Research Award, you must not apply for NPGS - the routes are mutually exclusive by design.
